verses: Tamam tareefen Allah hi kay laeeq hain jiss ney aasmano ko aur zamin ko peda kiya aur tareekiyon aur noor ko banaya phir bhi kafir log (ghair Allah ko) apney rab kay barabar qarar detay hain
Woh aisa hai jiss ney tum ko mitti say banaya phir aik waqt moyyen kiya aur (doosra) moyyen waqt khaas Allah hi kay nazdeek hai phir bhi tum shak rakhtay ho
Aur o hi hai mabood bar-haq aasmano mein bhi aur zamin mein bhi, woh tumharay posheedah ehwaal ko bhi aur tumharay zahir ehwaal ko bhi janta hai aur tum jo kuch amal kertay ho uss ko bhi janta hai
Aur unn kay pass koi nishani bhi unn kay rab ki nishaniyon mein nahi aati magar woh uss say aeyraaz hi kertay hain
Unhon ney uss sachi kitab ko bhi jhutlaya jab kay woh unn kay pass phonchi, so jaldi hi unn ko khabar mill jaye gi uss cheez ki jiss kay sath yeh log istehzaa kiya kertay thay

Kiya unhon ney dekha nahi kay hum unn say pehlay kitni jamaton ko halak ker chukay hain jin ko hum ney duniya mein aisi qooat di thi kay tum ko woh qooat nahi di aur hum ney unn per khoob barishen barsaeen aur hum ney unn kay neechay say nehren jari kin. Phir hum ney unn ko unn kay gunahon kay sabab halak ker dala aur unn kay baad doosri jamaton ko peda ker diya
Aur agar hum kaghaz per likha hua koi navishta aap per nazil farmatay phir uss ko yeh log apney hathon say chu bhi letay tab bhi yeh kafir log yehi kehtay kay yeh kuch bhi nahi magar sareeh jadoo hai
Aur yeh log yun kehtay hain kay unn kay pass koi farishta kiyon nahi utara gaya aur agar hum koi farishta bhej detay to sara qissa hi khatam hojata. Phir unn ko zara mohlat na di jati
Aur agar hum uss ko farishta tajweez kertay to hum uss ko aadmi hi banatay aur humaray uss fail say phir unn per o hi ashkaal hota jo abb ashkaal ker rahey hain
Aur waqaee aap say pehlay jo payghumbar huye hain unn kay sath bhi istehzaa kiya gaya hai. Phir jin logon ney unn say mazaq kiya tha unn ko uss azab ney aa ghera jiss ka tamaskhur uratay thay
Aap farma dijiye kay zara zamin mein chalo phiro phir dekh lo kay takzeeb kerney walon ka kiya anjam hua

Aap kahiye kay jo kuch aasmano aur zamin mein mojood hai yeh sab kiss ki milkiyat hai, aap keh dijiye kay sab Allah hi ki milkiyat hai, Allah ney meharbani farmana apney upper lazim farma liya hai tum ko Allah qayamat kay roz jama keray ga, uss mein koi shak nahi, jin logon ney apney aap ko ghatay mein dala hai so woh eman nahi layen gay
Aur Allah hi ki mulk hain woh sab kuch jo raat mein aur din mein rehti hain aur o hi bara sunnay wala bara jannay wala hai

Aap kahiye kay kiya Allah kay siwa, jo kay aasmano aur zamin ka peda kerney wala hai aur jo kay khaney ko deta hai aur uss ko koi khaney ko nahi deta, aur kissi ko mabood qarar doon, aap farma dijiye kay mujh ko yeh hukum hua hai kay sab say pehlay mein islam qabool keroon aur to mushrikeen mein hergiz na hona
Aap keh dijiye kay mein agar apney rab ka kehna na manon to mein aik baray din kay azab say darta hun
Jiss shakhs say uss roz woh azab hata diya jaye to uss per Allah ney bara reham kiya aur yeh sareeh kaamyabi hai

Aur agar tujh ko Allah Taalaa koi takleef phonchaye to uss ka door kerney wala siwaye Allah Taalaa kay aur koi nahi. Aur agar tujh ko Allah Taalaa koi nafa phonchaye to woh her cheez per poori qudrat rakhney wala hai
Aur o hi Allah apney bandon kay upper ghalib hai bartar hai aur o hi bari hikmat wala aur poori khabar rakhney wala hai

Aap kahiye kay sab say bari cheez gawahi denay kay liye kaun hai, aap kahiye kay meray aur tumharay darmiyan Allah gawah hai aur meray pass yeh Quran bator wahee kay bheja gaya hai takay mein uss Quran kay zariye say tum ko aur jiss jiss ko yeh Quran phonchay unn sab ko daraon kiya tum sach much yehi gawahi do gay kay Allah Taalaa kay sath kuch aur mabood bhi hain, aap keh dijiye kay mein to gawahi nahi deta. Aap farma dijiye kay bus woh to aik hi mabood hai aur be-shak mein tumharay shirk say beyzaar hun
Jin logon ko hum ney kitab di hai woh log rasool ko pehchantay hain jiss tarah apney beton ko pehchantay hain. Jin logon ney apney aap ko ghatay mein dala hai so woh eman nahi layen gay
Aur uss say ziyadah be-insaf kaun hoga jo Allah Taalaa per jhoot bohtan bandhay ya Allah ki aayaat ko jhoota batlaye aisay insafon ko kaamyabi na hogi

Aur woh waqt bhi yaad kerney kay qabil hai jiss roz hum unn tamam khalaeeq ko jama keren gay, phir hum mushrikeen say kahen gay kay tumharay woh shurka, jin kay mabood honey ka tum dawa kertay thay, kahan gaye?
Phir unn kay shirk ka anjam uss kay siwa aur kuch bhi na hoga kay woh yun kahen gay kay qasam Allah ki apney perwerdigar ki hum mushrik na thay
Zara dekho to unhon ney kiss tarah jhoot bola apni janon per aur jin cheezon ko woh jhoot moot tarasha kertay thay woh sab ghaeeb hogaye

Aur unn mein baaz aisay hain kay aap ki taraf kaan lagatay hain aur hum ney unn kay dilon per pardah daal rakha hai uss say kay woh uss ko samjhen aur unn kay kanon mein daat dey rakhi hai aur agar woh log tamam dalaeel ko dekh len to bhi unn per kabhi eman na layen, yahan tak kay jab yeh log aap kay pass aatay hain to aap say khuwah ma-khuwa jhagartay hain, yeh log jo kafir hain yun kehtay hain kay yeh to kuch bhi nahi sirf bey sanad baaten hain jo pehlon say chali aa rahi hain
Aur yeh log uss say doosron ko bhi roktay hain aur khud bhi uss say door door rehtay hain aur yeh log apney hi ko tabah ker rahey hain aur kuch khabar nahi rakhtay

Aur agar aap uss waqt dekhen jab kay yeh dozakh kay pass kharay kiye jayen to kahen gay haaye kiya achi baat ho kay hum phir wapis bhej diye jayen aur agar aisa ho jaye to hum apney rab ki aayaat ko jhoota na batlayen aur hum eman walon mein say ho jayen

Balkay)yeh jiss cheez ko uss kay qabal chupaya kertay thay woh unn kay samney aagaee hai aur agar yeh log phir wapis bhej diye jayen tab bhi yeh o hi kaam keren gay jiss say unn ko mana kiya gaya tha aur yaqeenan yeh bilkul jhootay hain
Aur yeh kehtay hain kay sirf yehi dunyawi zindagi humari zindagi hai aur hum zindah na kiye jayen gay

Aur agar aap uss waqt dekhen jab yeh apney rab kay samney kharay kiye jayen gay. Allah farmaye ga kay kiya yeh amar waqaee nahi hai? Woh kahen gay be-shak qasam apney rab ki. Allah Taalaa farmaye ga to abb apney kufur kay ewaz azab chakho

Be-shak khasarah mein paray woh log jinhon ney Allah say milney ki takzeeb ki, yahan tak kay jab woh moyyen waqt unn per dafatan aa phonchay ga, kahen gay kay haaye afsos humari kotahi per jo uss kay baray mein hui, aur halat unn ki yeh hogi kay woh apney baar apni peethon per laaday hun gay, khoob sunn lo kay buri hogi woh cheez jiss ko woh laaden gay
Aur dunyawi zindagani to kuch bhi nahi ba-juz lahoo o laab kay. Aur daar aakhirat muttaqiyon kay liye behtar hai. Kiya tum sochtay samajhtay nahi ho
Hum khoob jantay hain kay aap ko unn kay aqwaal maghmoom kertay hain, so yeh log aap ko jhoota nahi kehtay lekin yeh zalim to Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay hain

Aur boht say payghumbar jo aap say pehlay huye hain unn ki bhi takzeeb ki jaa chuki hai so unhon ney uss per sabar hi kiya, unn ki takzeeb ki gaee aur unn ko ezayen phonchaee gaeen yahan tak kay humari imdad unn ko phonchi aur Allah ki baaton ka koi badalney wala nahi aur aap kay pass baaz payghumbaron ki baaz khabren phonch chuki hain

Aur agar aap ko unn ka aeyraaz giran guzarta hai to agar aap ko yeh qudrat hai kay zamin mein koi surang ya aasman mein koi seerhi dhoond lo phir koi moajza ley aao to kero aur agar Allah ko manzoor hota to unn sab ko raah raast per jama ker deta so aap nadanon mein say na ho jaiye
O hi log qabool kertay hain jo suntay hain. Aur mardon ko Allah zindah ker kay uthaye ga phir sab Allah hi ki taraf laye jayen gay

Aur yeh log kehtay hain kay unn per koi moajza kiyon nahi nazil kiya gaya unn kay rab ki taraf say aap farma dijiye kay Allah Taalaa ko be-shak poori qudrat hai uss per kay woh moajza nazil farma. Lekin unn mein aksar bey-khabar hain

Aur jitney qasam kay jaandaar zamin per chalney walay hain aur jitney qasam kay parind janwar hain kay apney dono baazoo’on say urtay hain unn mein koi qasam aisi nahi jo kay tumhari tarah kay giroh na hun, hum ney daftar mein koi cheez nahi chori phir sab apney perwerdigar kay pass jama kiye jayen gay

Aur jo log humari aayaton ki takzeeb kertay hain woh to tarah tarah ki zulmaton mein behray goongay ho rahey hain, Allah jiss ko chahaye bey raah kerdey aur woh jiss ko chahaye seedhi raah per laga dey
Aap kahiye kay apna haal to batlao kay agar tum per Allah ka koi azab aa paray ya tum per qayamat hi aa phonchay to kiya Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko pukaro gay. Agar tum sachay ho
Balkay)yeh khaas ussi ko pukaro gay, phir jiss kay liye tum pukaro gay agar woh chahaye to uss ko hata bhi dey aur jin ko tum shareek thehratay ho unn sab ko bhool bhaal jao gay
Aur hum ney aur ummaton ki taraf bhi jo kay aap say pehlay guzar chuki hain payghumbar bhejay thay, so hum ney unn ko tangdast aur beemari say pakra takay woh izhar ijz saken
So jab unn ko humari saza phonchi thi to unhon ney aajzi kiyon nahi ikhtiyar ki? Lekin unn kay quloob sakht hogaye aur shetan ney unn kay aemaal ko unn kay khayal mein aaraasta kerdiya

Phir jab woh log unn cheezon ko bhoolay rahey jin ki unn ko naseehat ki jati thi to hum ney unn per her cheez kay darwazay kushadah kerdiey yahan tak kay jab unn cheezon per jo kay unn ko mili thin woh khoob itra gaye hum ney unn ko dafatan pakar liya, phir to woh bilkul mayyus hogaye
Phir zalim logon ki jarr kat gaee aur Allah Taalaa ka shukar hai jo tamam aalam ka perwerdigar hai

Aap kahiye kay yeh batlao agar Allah Taalaa tumhari sama’at aur basarat bilkul ley ley aur tumharay dilon per mehar kerdey to Allah Taalaa kay siwa aur koi mabood hai kay yeh tum ko phir dey dey. Aap dekhiye to hum kiss tarah dalaeel ko mukhtalif pehloo’on say paish ker rahey hain phir bhi yeh aeyraaz kertay hain
Aap kahiye kay yeh batlao agar tum per Allah Taalaa ka azab aa paray khuwah achanak ya aelaaniya to kiya ba-juz zalim logon kay aur bhi koi halak kiya jaye ga
Aur hum payghumbaron ko sirf uss wastay bheja kertay hain kay woh bisharat den aur darayen phir jo eman ley aaye aur durusti kerley so unn logon per koi andesha nahi aur na woh maghmoom hun gay
Aur jo log humari aayaton ko jhoota batlayen unn ko azab phonchay ga ba-waja uss kay kay woh na-farmani kertay hain

Aap keh dijiye kay na to mein tum say yeh kehta hun kay meray pass Allah kay khazaney hain aur na mein ghaib janta hun aur na mein tum say yeh kehta hun kay mein farishta hun. Mein to sirf jo kuch meray pass wahee aati hai uss ki ittabaa kerta hun aap kahiye kay andha aur beena kahen barabar hosakta hai. So kiya tum ghor nahi kertay?

Aur aisay logon ko daraiye jo uss baat say andesha rakhtay hain kay apney rab kay pass aisi halat mein jama kiye jayen gay kay jitney ghair Allah hain na koi unn ka madadgar hoga aur na koi shafi, uss umeed per kay woh darr jayen

Aur unn logon ko na nikaliye jo subha o shaam apney perwerdigar ki ibadat kertay hain, khaas ussi ki razamandi ka qasad rakhtay hain. Unn ka hisab zara bhi aap kay mutalliq nahi aur aap ka hisab zara bhi unn kay mutalliq nahi kay aap unn ko nikal den. Werna aap zulm kerney walon mein say ho jayen gay

Aur ussi tarah hum ney baaz ko baaz kay zariye say aazmaeesh mein daal rakha hai takay yeh log kaha keren, kiya yeh log hain kay hum sab mein say unn per Allah Taalaa ney fazal kiya hai. Kiya yeh baat nahi hai kay Allah Taalaa shukar guzaron ko khoob janta hai

Aur yeh log jab aap kay pass aayen jo humari aayaton per eman rakhtay hain to (yun) keh dijiye kay tum per salamti hai tumharay rab ney meharbani farmana apney zimmay muqarrar kerliya hai kay jo shakhs tum mein say bura kaam ker bethay jahalat say phir woh uss kay baad tauba ker ley aur islaah rakhay to Allah (ki yeh shaan hai kay woh) bari maghfirat kerney wala hai bari rehmat wala hai
Ussi tarah hum aayaat ki tafseel kertay rehtay hain aur takay mujrimeen ka tareeqa zahir hojaye

Aap keh dijiye kay mujh ko uss say moomaniyat ki gaee hai kay unn ki ibadat keroon jin ko tum log Allah Taalaa ko chor ker pukartay ho. Aap keh dijiye kay mein tumhari khuwaishaat ki ittabaa na keroon ga kiyon kay uss halat mein to mein bey raah hojaoon ga aur raah raast per chalney walon mein na rahon ga

Aap keh dijiye kay meray pass to aik daleel hai meray rab ki taraf say aur tum uss ki takzeeb kertay ho, jiss cheez ki tum jald ker rahey ho woh meray pass nahi. Hukum kissi ka nahi ba-juz Allah Taalaa kay Allah Taalaa waqaee baat ko batla deta hai aur sab say acha faisla kerney wala o hi hai
Aap keh dijiye kay agar meray pass woh cheez hoti jiss ka tum taqaza ker rahey ho to mera aur tumhara bahumi qissa faisal chuka hota aur zalimon ko Allah Taalaa khoob janta hai

Aur Allah Taalaa hi kay pass hain ghaib ki kunjiyan, (khazaney) unn ko koi nahi janta ba-juz Allah kay. Aur woh tamam cheezon ko janta hai jo kuch khushki mein hain aur jo kuch daryaon mein hain aur koi patta nahi girta magar woh uss ko bhi janta hai aur koi dana zamin kay tareek hisson mein nahi parta aur na koi tar aur na koi khushk cheez girti hai magar yeh sab kitab mubeen mein hain

Aur woh aisa hai kay raat mein tumhari rooh ko (aik gona) qabz ker deta hai aur jo kuch tum din mein kertay ho uss ko janta hai phir tum ko jaga uthata hai takay miyad moyyen tamam ker di jaye phir ussi ki taraf tum ko jana hai phir tum ko batlaye ga jo kuch tum kiya kertay thay

Aur o hi apney bandon kay upper ghalib hai bartar hai aur tum per nigehdasht rakhney walay bhejta hai yahan tak kay jab tum mein say kissi ko maut aa phonchti hai, uss ki rooh humaray bhejay huye farishtay qabz ker letay hain aur woh zara kotahi nahi kertay
Phir sab apney malik haqeeqi kay pass laye jayen gay. Khoob sunn lo faisla Allah hi ka hoga aur woh boht jald hisab ley ga

Aap kahiye kay woh kaun hai jo tum ko khushki aur darya ki zulmat say nijat deta hai. Tum uss ko pukartay ho girgira ker chupkay chupkay, kay agar to hum ko unn say nijat dey dey to hum zaroor shukar kerney walon mein say hojayen gay
Aap keh dijiye kay Allah hi tum ko unn say nijat deta hai aur her ghum say, tum phir bhi shirk kerney lagtay ho

Aap kahiye kay uss per bhi o hi qadir hai kay tum per koi azab tumharay upper say bhej dey ya tumharay paon talay say ya kay tum ko giroh giroh kerkay sab ko bhira dey aur tumharay aik ko doosray ki laraee chakha dey. Aap dekhiye to sahi hum kiss tarah dalaeel mukhtalif pehloo’on say biyan kertay hain shayad woh samajh jayen
Aur aap ki qom uss ki takzeeb kerti hai halankay woh yaqeeni hai. Aap keh dijiye kay mein tum per taaeenaat nahi kiya gaya hun
Her khabar (kay waqoo) ka aik waqt hai aur jald hi tum ko maloom hojaye ga

Aur jab aap unn ko logon ko dekhen jo humari aayaat mein aib joee ker rahey hain to unn logon say kinara kash hojayen yahan tak kay woh kissi aur baat mein lag jayen aur agar aap ko shetan bhala dey to yaad aaney kay baad phir aisay zalim logon kay sath mat bethen
Aur jo log perhezgar hain unn per unn ki baaz purs ka koi asar na phonchay ga aur lekin unn kay zimmay naseehat ker dena hai shayad woh taqwa ikhtiyar keren

Aur aisay logon say bilkul kinara kash rahen jinhon ney apney deen ko khel tamasha bana rakha hai aur dunyawi zindagi ney unhen dhokay mein daal rakha hai aur uss Quran kay zariye say naseehat bhi kertay rahen takay koi shakhs apney kirdaar kay sabab (uss tarah) na phans jaye kay koi ghair Allah uss ka na madadgar ho aur na sifarshi aur yeh keyfiyat ho kay agar duniya bhar ka maawza bhi dey dalay tab bhi uss say na liya jaye. Aisay hi hain kay apney kirdaar kay sabab phans gaye, unn kay liye nihayat tez garum pani peenay kay liye hoga aur dard-naak saza hogi apney kufur kay sabab

Aap keh dijiye kay kiya hum Allah Taalaa kay siwa aisi cheez ko pukaren kay na woh hum ko nafa phonchaye aur na hum ko nuksan phonchaye aur kiya hum ultay phir jayen uss kay baad kay hum ko Allah Taalaa ney hidayat kerdi hai, jaisay koi shakhs ho kay uss ko shetanon ney kahen jangal mein be-raah kerdiya ho aur woh bhatakta phirta ho, uss kay kuch sathi bhi hun kay woh uss ko theek raasta ki taraf bula rahey hun kay humaray pass aa. Aap keh dijiye kay yaqeeni baat hai kay raah raast woh khaas Allah hi ki raah hai aur hum ko yeh hukum hua hai kay hum perwerdigar aalam kay pooray mutee hojayen
Aur yeh kay namaz ki pabandi kero aur uss say daro aur o hi hai jiss kay pass tum sab jama kiye jao gay

Aur o hi hai jiss ney aasmano aur zamin ko bar-haq peda kiya aur jiss waqt Allah Taalaa itna keh dey ga to hoja bus woh ho paray ga. Uss ka kehna haq aur ba-asar hai. Aur sari hukoomat khaas ussi ki hogi jab kay soor mein phoonk maari jaye gi woh jannay wala hai posheedah cheezon ka aur zahir cheezon ka aur o hi hai bari hikmat wala poori khabar rakhney wala

Aur woh waqt bhi yaad kerney kay qabil hai jab Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ney apney baap aazar say farmaya kay kiya to buton ko mabood qarar deta hai? Be-shak mein tujh ko aur teri sari qom ko sareeh gumrahi mein dekhta hun
Aur hum ney aisay hi tor per Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ko aasmano aur zamin ki makhlooqaat dikhlaeen aur takay kamil yaqeen kerney walon mein say hojayen

Phir jab raat ki tareeki unn per cha gaee to unhon ney aik sitara dekha aap ney farmaya kay yeh mera rab hai magar jab woh ghuroob hogaya to aap ney farmaya kay mein ghuroob hojaney walon say mohabbat nahi rakhta

Phir jab chand ko dekha chamakta hua to farmaya kay yeh mera rab hai lekin jab woh ghuroob hogaya to aap ney farmaya kay agar mujh ko meray rab ney hidayat na ki to mein gumrah logon mein shamil hojaoon ga
Phir jab aftab ko dekha chamakta hua to farmaya kay yeh mera rab hai yeh to sab say bara hai phir jab woh bhi ghuroob hogaya to aap ney farmaya be-shak mein tumharay shirk say beyzaar hun
Mein apna rukh uss ki taraf kerta hun jiss ney aasmano aur zamin ko peda kiya yaksoo ho ker, aur mein shirk kerney walon mein say nahi hun

Aur unn say unn ki qom ney hujjat kerna shuroo kiya, aap ney farmaya kiya tum Allah kay moamla mein mujh say hujjat kertay ho halankay uss ney mujh ko tareeqa batla diya hai aur mein unn cheezon say jin ko tum Allah kay sath shareek banatay ho nahi darta haan agar mera perwerdigar hi koi amar chahaye mera perwerdigar her cheez ko apney ilm mein gheray huye hai, kiya tum phir bhi khayal nahi kertay

Aur mein unn cheezon say kaisay darron jin ko tum ney shareek banaya hai halankay tum uss baat say nahi dartay kay tum ney Allah kay sath aisi cheezon ko shareek thehraya hai jin per Allah Taalaa ney koi daleel nazil nahi farmaee, so unn do jamaton mein say aman ka ziyadah mustahiq kaun hai agar tum khabar rakhtay ho
Jo log eman rakhtay hain aur apney eman ko shirk kay sath makhloot nahi kertay, aison hi kay liye aman hai aur o hi raah raast per chal rahey hain

Aur yeh humari hujjat thi woh hum ney Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ko unn ki qom kay muqablay mein di thi hum jiss ko chahatay hain martabon mein barha detay hain. Be-shak aap ka rab bara hikmat wala bara ilm wala hai

Aur hum ney unn ko Ishaq diya aur Yaqoob her aik ko hum ney hidayat ki aur pehlay zamaney mein hum ney Nooh ko hidayat ki aur unn ki aulad mein say Dawood ko aur Sulaiman ko aur Ayyub ko aur Yusuf ko aur Musa ko aur Haroon ko aur ussi tarah hum nek kaam kerney walon ko jaza diya kertay hain
Aur (naiz) Zakariya ko aur yahya ko aur Isa ko aur ilyas ko, sab nek logon mein say thay
Aur naiz Ismail ko aur yasaa ko aur Yunus ko aur Loot ko aur her aik ko tamam jahaan walon per hum ney fazilat di
Aur naiz unn kay kuch baap dadon ko aur kuch aulad ko aur kuch bhaiyon ko, aur hum ney unn ko maqbool banaya aur hum ney unn ko raah raast ki hidayat ki

Allah ki hidayat hi hai jiss kay zariye apney bandon mein say jiss ko chahaye uss ki hidayat kerta hai aur agar farzan yeh hazraat bhi shirk kertay to jo kuch yeh aemaal kertay thay woh sab ikaarat hojatay

Yeh log aisay thay kay hum ney unn ko kitab aur hikmat aur naboowat ata ki thi so agar yeh log naboowat ka inkar keren to hum ney uss kay liye aisay boht say log muqarrar kerdiye hain jo uss kay munkir nahi hain

Yehi log aisay thay jin ko Allah Taalaa ney hidayat ki thi, so aap bhi unn hi kay tareeq per chaliye aap keh dijiye kay mein tum say uss per koi maawza nahi chahata yeh to sirf tamam jahaan walon kay wastay aik naseehat hai

Aur unn logon ney, Allah ki jaisi qadar kerna wajib thi wesi qadar na ki jab kay yun keh diya kay Allah ney kissi bashar per koi cheez nazil nahi ki aap yeh kahiye kay woh kitab kiss ney nazil ki hai jiss ko Musa laye thay jiss ki keyfiyat yeh hai kay woh noor hai aur logon kay liye woh hidayat hai jiss ko tum ney unn mutafarriq oraaq mein rakh chora hai jin ko zahir kertay ho aur boht si baaton ko chupatay ho aur tum ko boht si aisi baaten bataee gaee hain jin ko tum na jantay thay aur na tumharay baray. Aap keh dijiye kay Allah ney nazil farmaya hai phir unn ko unn kay kharafaat mein kheltay rehney dijiye

Aur yeh bhi aisi hi kitab hai jiss ko hum ney nazil kiya hai jo bari barkat wali hai, apney say pehli kitabon ki tasdeeq kerney wali hai aur takay aap Makkah walon ko aur aas pass walon ko darayen. Aur jo log aakhirat ka yaqeen rakhtay hain aisay log uss per eman ley aatay hain aur woh apni namaz per madawmat rakhtay hain

Aur uss shakhs say ziyadah kaun zalim hoga jo Allah Taalaa per jhoot tohmat lagaye ya yun kahey kay mujh per wahee aati hai halankay uss kay pass kissi baat ki bhi wahee nahi aaee aur jo shakhs yun kahey kay jaisa kalaam Allah ney nazil kiya hai ussi tarah ka mein bhi laata hun aur agar aap uss waqt dekhen jab kay yeh zalim log maut ki sakhtiyon mein hun gay aur farishtay apney hath barha rahey hun gay kay haan apni janen nikalo. Aaj tum ko zillat ki saza di jaye gi uss sabab say kay tum Allah Taalaa kay zimmay jhooti baaten lagatay thay, aur tum Allah Taalaa ki aayaat say takabbur kertay thay

Aur tum humaray pass tanha tanha aagaye jiss tarah hum ney awwal baar tum ko peda kiya tha aur jo kuch hum ney tum ko diya tha uss ko apney peechay hi chor aaye aur hum to tumharay humrah tumharay unn shifaat kerney walon ko nahi dekhtay jin ki nisbat tum dawa rakhtay thay kay woh tumharay moamlay mein shareek hain. Waqaee tumharay aapas mein to qata talluq hogaya aur woh tumhara dawa sab tum say gaya guzra hua

Be-shak Allah Taalaa dana ko aur guthliyon ko phaarney wala hai, woh jaandaar ko bey jaan say nikal laata hai aur woh bey jaan ko jaandaar say nikalney wala hai Allah Taalaa yeh hai, so tum kahan ultay chalay jaa rahey ho
Woh subha ka nikalney wala hai aur uss ney raat ko rahat ki cheez bana ya hai aur sooraj aur chand ko hisab say rakha hai. Yeh thehraee baat hai aisi zaat ki jo kay qadir hai baray ilm wala hai

Aur woh aisa hai jiss ney tumharay liye sitaron ko peda kiya, takay tum unn kay zariye say andheron mein, khushki mein aur darya mein bhi raasta maloom ker sako. Be-shak hum ney dalaeel khoob khol khol ker biyan kerdiye hain unn logon kay liye jo khabar rakhtay hain

Aur woh aisa hai jiss ney tum ko aik shakhs say peda kiya phir aik jagah ziyadah rehney ki hai aur aik jagah chanday, rehney ki be-shak hum dalaeel khoob khol khol ker biyan kerdiye unn logon kay liye jo samajh bojh rakhtay hain

Aur woh aisa hai jiss ney aasman say pani barsaya phir hum ney uss kay zariye say her qasam kay nabaat ko nikala phir hum ney uss say sabz shaakh nikali kay uss say hum upper talay daney charhay huye nikaltay hain aur khajoor kay darakhton say yani unn kay guphay mein say, khoshay hain jo neechay ko latkay jatay hain aur angooron kay baagh aur zaitoon aur anaar kay baaz aik doosray say miltay jultay hotay hain aur kuch aik doosray say miltay jultay nahi hotay. Her aik kay phal ko dekho jab woh phalta hai aur uss kay pakney ko dekho unn mein dalaeel hain unn logon kay liye jo eman rakhtay hain

Aur logon ney shayateen ko Allah Taalaa ka shareek qarar dey rakha hai halankay unn logon ko Allah hi ney peda kiya hai aur unn logon ney Allah kay haq mein betay aur betiyan bula sanad taraash rakhi hain aur woh pak aur bartar hai unn baaton say jo yeh kertay hain
Woh aasmano aur zamin ka mojid hai, Allah Taalaa kay aulad kahan hosakti hai halankay uss kay koi biwi to hai nahi aur Allah Taalaa ney her cheez ko peda kiya aur woh her cheez ko khoob janta hai
Yeh hai Allah Taalaa tumhara rab! uss kay siwa koi ibadat kay laeeq nahi, her cheez ka peda kerney wala hai, to tum uss ki ibadat kero aur woh her cheez ka kaarsaaz hai
Uss ko to kissi ki nigah moheet nahi hosakti aur woh sab nigahon ko moheet ho jata hai aur o hi bara bareek been ba-khabar hai

Abb bila-shuba tumharay pass tumharay rab ki janib say haq beeni kay zaraye phonch chukay hain so jo shakhs dekh ley ga woh apna faeedah keray ga aur jo shakhs andha rahey ga woh apna nuksan keray ga, aur mein tumhara nigaraan nahi hun
Aur hum uss tor per dalaeel ko mukhtalif pehloo’on say biyan kertay hain takay yeh yun kahen kay aap ney kissi say parh liya hai aur takay hum uss ko mandon kay liye khoob zahir ker den
Aap khud uss tareeq per chaltay rahiye jiss ki wahee aap kay rab Taalaa ki taraf say aap kay pass aaee hai, Allah Taalaa kay siwa koi laeeq ibadat nahi aur mushrikeen ki taraf khayal na kijiye
Aur agar Allah Taalaa ko manzoor hota to yeh shirk na kertay aur hum ney aap ko unn ka nigaraan nahi banaya. Aur na aap unn per mukhtar hain

Aur gaali mat do unn ko jin ki yeh log Allah Taalaa ko chor ker ibadat kertay hain kyunkay phir woh barah jahl hadd say guzar ker Allah Taalaa ki shaan mein gustakhi keren gay hum ney ussi tarah her tareeqa walon ko unn ka amal marghoob bana rakha hai. Phir apney rab hi kay pass unn ko jana hai so woh unn ko batla dey ga jo kuch bhi woh kiya kertay thay

Aur unn logon ney qasmon mein bara zor laga ker Allah Taalaa ki qasam khaee kay agar unn kay pass koi nishani aa jaye to woh zaroor hi uss per eman ley aayen gay, aap keh dijiye kay nishaniyan sab Allah kay qabzay mein hain aur tum ko uss ki kiya khabar kay woh nishaniyan jiss waqt aajayen gi yeh log tab bhi eman na layen gay
Aur hum bhi unn kay dilon ko aur unn ki nigahon ko pher den gay jaisa kay yeh log uss per pehli dafa eman nahi laye aur hum unn ko unn ki sirkashi mein heyraan rehney den gay

Aur agar hum unn kay pass farishton ko bhej detay aur unn say murday baaten kerney lagtay aur hum tamam mojodaat ko unn kay pass unn ki aankhon kay roo-baroo laa ker jama ker detay hain tab bhi yeh log hergiz eman na latay haan agar Allah hi chahaye to aur baat hai lekin unn mein ziyadah log jahalat ki baaten kertay hain

Aur ussi tarah hum ney her nabi kay dushman boht say shetan peda kiye thay kuch aadmi aur kuch jin, jin mein say baaz baazon ko chikni chupri baaton ka waswasa daaltay rehtay thay takay unn ko dhokay mein daal den aur agar Allah Taalaa chahata to yeh aisay kaam na saktay so unn logon ko aur jo kuch yeh iftra perdaazi ker rahey hain uss ko aap rehney dijiye
Aur takay uss ki taraf unn logon kay quloob maeel hojayen jo aakhirat per yaqeen nahi rakhtay aur takay uss ko pasand kerlen aur takay murtakib hojayen unn umoor kay jin kay woh murtakib hotay thay

To kiya Allah kay siwa kissi aur faisla kerney walay ko talash keroon halankay woh aisa hai kay uss ney aik kitab kamil tumharay pass bhej di hai, uss kay mazmeen khoob saaf saaf biyan kiye gaye hain aur jin logon ko hum ney kitab di hai woh uss baat ko yaqeen kay sath jantay hain kay yeh aap kay rab ki taraf say haq kay sath bheji gaee hai, so aap shuba)yeh kerney walon mein say na hun
Aap kay rab ka kalaam sachaee aur insaf kay aitbaar say kamil hai, uss kay kalaam ka koi badalney wala nahi aur woh khoob sunnay wala khoob jannay wala hai

Aur duniya mein ziyadah log aisay hain kay agar aap unn ka kehna mannay lagen to woh aap ko Allah ki raah say bey raah ker den woh mehaz bey asal khayalaat per chaltay hain aur bilkul qayassi baaten kertay hain
Bil-yaqeen aap ka rab unn ko khoob janta hai jo uss ki raah say bey raah hojata hai. Aur woh unn ko bhi khoob janta hai jo uss ki raah per chaltay hain
So jiss janwar per Allah Taalaa ka naam liya jaye uss mein say khao! agar tum uss kay ehkaam per eman rakhtay ho

Aur aakhir kiya wajah hai kay tum aisay janwar mein say na khao jiss per Allah ka naam liya gaya ho halankay Allah Taalaa ney unn sab janwaron ki tafseel bata hai jin ko tum per haram kiya hai, magar woh bhi jab tum ko sakht zaroorat parr to halal hai aur yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay boht say aadmi apney khayalaat per bula kissi sanad kay gumrah kertay hain. Uss mein koi shuba)yeh nahi kay Allah Taalaa hadd say nikal janey walon ko khoob janta hai
Aur tum zahiri gunah ko bhi chor do aur baatini gunah ko bhi chor do. Bila-shuba jo log gunah rahey hain unn ko unn kay kiye ki unqareeb saza milay gi

Aur aisay janwaron mein say mat khao jin per Allah ka naam na liya gaya ho aur yeh kaam na-farmani ka hai aur yaqeenan shayateen apney doston kay dil mein daaltay hain takay yeh tum say jidal keren aur agar tum unn logon ki ita’at kerney lago to yaqeenan tum mushrik hojao gay

Aisa shakhs jo pehlay murdah tha phir hum ney uss ko zindah kerdiya aur hum ney uss ko aik aisa noor dey diya kay woh uss ko liye huye aadmiyon mein chalta phirta hai. Kiya aisa shakhs uss shakhs ki tarah hosakta hai? Jo tareekiyon say nikal hi nahi pata. Ussi tarah kafiron ko unn kay aemaal khush numa maloom hua kertay hain
Aur ussi tarah hum ney her basti mein o haan kay raeeson hi ko jaraeem ka murtakib banaya takay woh log o haan fareb keren. Aur woh log apney hi sath fareb rahey hain aur unn ko zara khabar nahi

Aur jab unn ko koi aayat phonchti hai to yun kehtay hain kay hum hergiz eman na layen gay jab tak kay hum ko bhi aisi hi cheez na di jaye jo Allah kay rasoolon ko di jati hai, uss moqay ko to Allah hi khoob janta hai kay kahan woh apni payghumbari rakhay? Unqareeb unn logon ko jinhon ney jurum kiya hai Allah kay pass phonch ker zillat phonchay gi aur unn ki shararaton kay muqablay mein sakht sazayen

So jiss shakhs ko Allah Taalaa raasta per daalna chahaye uss kay seena ko islam kay liye kushadah ker deta hai aur jiss ko bey raah rakhna chahaye uss kay seena ko boht tang ker deta hai jaisay koi aasman mein charhta hai, ussi tarah Allah Taalaa eman na laney walon per paki musallat ker deta hai
Aur yehi teray rab ka seedha raasta hai. Hum ney naseehat hasil kerney walon kay wastay unn aayaton ko saaf saaf biyan kerdiya
Unn logon kay wastay unn kay rab kay pass salamti ka ghar hai aur Allah Taalaa unn say mohabbat rakhta hai unn kay aemaal ki wajah say

Aur jiss roz Allah Taalaa tamam khalaeeq ko jama keray ga, (kahey ga) aey jamat jinnat ki! tum ney insano mein say boht say apna liye jo insan unn kay sath talluq rakhney walay thay woh kahen gay kay aey humaray perwerdigar! hum mein aik ney doosray say faeedah hasil kiya tha aur hum apni uss moyyen miyad tak phonchay jo tu ney humaray liye moyyen farmaee, Allah farmaye ga kay tum sab ka thikana dozakh hai jiss mein hamesha raho gay, haan agar Allah hi ko manzoor ho to doosri baat hai. Bey shak aap ka rab bari hikmat wala bara ilm wala hai
Aur ussi tarah hum baaz kuffaar ko baaz kay qareeb rakhen gay unn kay aemaal kay sabab

Aey jinnat aur insano ki jamat! kiya tumharay pass tum mein say hi payghumbar nahi aaye thay, jo tum say meray ehkaam biyan kertay aur tum ko uss aaj kay din ki khabar detay? Woh sab arz keren gay kay hum apney upper iqrar kertay hain aur unn ko dunyawi zindagi ney bhool mein dalay rakha aur yeh log iqrar kerney walay hun gay kay woh kafir thay
Yeh uss wajah say hai kay aap ka rab kissi basti walon ko kufur kay sabab aisi halat mein halak nahi kerta kay uss basti kay rehney walay bey khabar hun
Aur her aik kay liye unn kay aemaal kay sabab darjay milen gay aur aap ka rab unn kay aemaal say bey khabar nahi hai

Aur aap ka rab bilkul ghani hai rehmat wala hai. Agar woh chahaye to tum sab ko utha ley aur tumharay baad jiss ko chahaye tumhari jagah abad kerdey jaisa kay tum ko aik doosri qom ki nasal say peda kiya hai
Jiss cheez ka tum say wada kiya jata hai woh bey shak aaney wali cheez hai aur tum aajiz nahi saktay

Aap yeh farma dijiye kay aey meri qom! tum apni halat per amal kertay raho mein bhi amal raha hun, so abb jald hi tum ko maloom hua jata hai kay uss aalam ka anjam kaar kiss kay liye naafay hoga. Yeh yaqeeni baat hai kay haq talfi kerney walon ko kabhi falah na hogi

Aur Allah Taalaa ney jo kheti aur mawashi peda kiye hain unn logon ney unn mein say kuch hissa Allah ka muqarrar kiya aur ba-zom khud kehtay hain kay yeh to Allah ka hai aur yeh humaray maboodon ka hai, phir jo cheez unn kay maboodon ki hoti hai woh to Allah ki taraf nahi phonchti aur jo cheez Allah ki hoti hai woh unn kay maboodon ki taraf phonch jati hai kiya bura faisla woh kertay hain

Aur ussi tarah boht say mushrikeen kay khayal mein unn kay maboodon ney unn ki aulad kay qatal kerney ko mustehsan bana rakha hai takay woh unn ko barbaad keren aur takay unn kay deen ko unn per mushtaba ker den aur agar Allah ko manzoor hota to yeh aisa kaam na kertay to aap unn ko aur jo kuch yeh ghalat baaten bana rahey hain yunhi rehney dijiye

Aur woh apney khayal per yeh bhi kehtay hain kay yeh kuch mawashi hain aur khet hain jin ka isteymaal her shakhs ko jaeez nahi unn ko koi nahi kha sakta siwaye unn kay jin ko hum chahayen aur mawashi hain jin per sawari ya bardari haram kerdi gaee aur kuch mawashi hain jin per yeh log Allah Taalaa ka naam nahi letay mehaz Allah per iftra bandhney kay tor per. Abhi Allah Taalaa unn ko unn kay iftra ki saza diye deta hai

Aur woh kehtay hain kay jo cheez unn mawashi kay pet mein hai woh khalis humaray mardon kay liye hai aur humari aurton per haram hai. Aur agar woh murdah hai to uss mein sab barabar hain. Abhi Allah unn ko unn ki ghalat biyani ki saza diye deta hai bila-shuba woh hikmat wala hai aur woh bara ilm wala hai

Waqaee kharabi mein parr gaye woh log jinhon ney apni aulad ko mehaz barah barah-e-himaqat bula kissi sanad kay qatal ker dala aur jo cheezen unn ko Allah ney khaney peenay ko di thin unn ko haram kerliya mehaz Allah per iftra bandhney kay tor per. Bey shak yeh log gumrahi mein parr aur kabhi raah raast per chalney walay nahi huye

Aur o hi hai jiss ney baghaat peda kiye woh bhi jo tattiyon per charhaye jatay hain aur woh bhi jo tattiyon per nahi charhaye jatay aur khajoor kay darakht aur kheti jin mein khaney ki cheezen mukhtalif tor ki hoti hain aur zaitoon aur anaar jo bahum aik doosray kay mushabay bhi hotay hain aur aik doosray kay mushabay nahi bhi hotay, unn sab kay phalon mein say khao jab woh nikal aaye aur uss mein jo haq wajib hai woh uss kay kaatney kay din diya kero aur hadd say mat guzro yaqeenan woh hadd say guzarney walon ko pasand kerta hai
Aur mawashi mein unchay qad kay aur chotay qad kay (peda kiye), jo kuch Allah ney tum ko diya hai khao aur shetan kay qadam qadam mat chalo, bila-shak woh tumhara sareeh dushman hai

(peda kiye) aath nurr o madah yani bheer mein do qasam aur bakri mein do qasam aap kahiye kay kiya Allah ney unn dono narron ko haram kiya hai ya dono madah ko? Ya uss ko jiss ko dono madah pet mein liye huye hun? Tum mujh ko kissi daleel say to batao agar sachay ho

Aur oont mein do qasam aur gaaye mein do qasam aap kahiye kay kiya Allah Taalaa ney unn dono narron ko haram kiya hai ya dono madah ko? Ya uss ko jiss ko dono madah pet mein liye huye hun? Kiya tum hazir thay jiss waqt Allah Taalaa ney tum ko uss ka hukum diya? To uss say ziyadah kaun zalim hoga jo Allah Taalaa per bula daleel jhooti tohmat lagaye, takay logon ko gumrah keray yaqeenan Allah Taalaa zalim logon ko raasta nahi dikhlata

Aap keh dijiye kay jo kuch ehkaam ba-zariya wahee meray pass aaye unn mein to mein koi haram nahi pata kissi khaney walay kay liye jo uss ko khaye, magar yeh kay woh murdaar ho ya kay bhyta hua khoon ho ya khinzeer ka gosht ho, kyunkay woh bilkul pak hai ya jo shirk ka zariye ho kay ghair-Allah kay liye naamzad kerdiya gaya ho. Phir jo shakhs majboor hojaye ba-shart-e-kay na to talib lazzat ho aur na tajawuz kerney wala ho to waqaee aap ka rab ghafoor o raheem hai

Aur yahud per hum ney tamam nakhun walay janwar haram kerdiye thay aur gaaye aur bakri mein say unn dono ki charbiyan unn per hum ney haram kerdi thin magar woh jo unn ki pusht per ya antriyon mein lagi ho ya jo haddi say mili ho. Unn ki shararat kay sabab hum ney unn ko yeh saza di aur hum yaqeenan sachay hain
Phir agar yeh aap ko kaazib kahen to aap farma dijiye kay tumhara rab bari wasee rehmat wala hai aur uss ka azab mujrim logon say na talay ga

Yeh mushrikeen (yun) kahen gay kay agar Allah Taalaa ko manzoor hota to na hum shirk kertay aur na humaray baap dada aur na hum kissi cheez ko haram keh saktay. Ussi tarah jo log unn say pehlay chukay hain unhon ney bhi takzeeb ki thi yahan tak kay unhon ney humaray azab ka maza chakha. Aap kahiye kay kiya tumharay pass koi daleel hai to uss ko humaray roo-baroo zahir kero. Tum log mehaz khayali baaton per chaltay ho aur tum bilkul atkal say baaten banatay ho
Aap kahiye kay bus poori hujjat Allah hi ki rahi. Phir agar woh chahata to tum sab ko raah raast per ley aata

Aap kahiye kay apney gawahon ko lao jo uss baat per shahdat den kay Allah ney unn cheezon ko haram kerdiya hai, phir agar woh gawahi dey den to aap uss ki shahdat na dijiye aur aisay logon kay baatil khayalaat ka ittabaa mat kijiye! jo humari aayaton ki takzeeb kertay hain aur woh jo aakhirat per eman nahi rakhtay aur woh apney rab kay barabar doosron ko thehratay hain

Aap kahiye kay aao mein tum ko woh cheezen parh ker sunaon jin (yani jin ki mukhalifat) ko tumharay rab ney tum per haram farma diya hai, woh yeh kay Allah kay sath kissi cheez ko shareek mat thehrao aur maa baap kay sath ehsan kero aur apni aulad ko aflaas kay sabab qatal mat kero. Hum tum ko aur unn ko rizq detay hain aur bey hayaee kay jitney tareeqay hain unn kay pass bhi mat jao khuwah aelaaniya hun khuwah posheedah, aur jiss ka khoon kerna Allah Taalaa ney haram kerdiya hai uss ko qatal mat kero, haan magar haq kay sath unn ka tum ko takeedi hukum diya hai takay tum samjho

Aur yateem kay maal kay pass na jao magar aisay tareeqay say jo kay mustehsan hai yahan tak kay woh apney sunn rashd ko phonch jaye aur naap tol poori poori kero, insaf kay sath, hum kissi shakhs ko uss ki taqat say ziyadah takleef nahi detay. Aur jab tum baat kero to insaf kero, go woh shakhs qarabat daar hi ho aur Allah Taalaa say jo ehad kiya uss ko poora kero, unn ka Allah Taalaa ney tum ko takeedi hukum diya hai takay tum yaad rakho

Aur yeh kay yeh deen mera raasta hai jo mustaqeem hai so uss raah per chalo aur doosri raahon per mat chalo kay woh raahen tum ko Allah ki raah say juda ker den gi. Uss ka tum ko Allah Taalaa ney takeedi hukum diya hai takay tum perhezgari ikhtiyar kero

Phir hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko kitab di thi jiss say achi tarah amal kerney walon per nemat poori ho aur sab ehkaam ki tafseel hojaye aur rehnumaee ho aur rehmat ho takay woh log apney rab kay milney per yaqeen layen
Aur yeh aik kitab hai jiss ko hum ney bheja bari khair o barkat wali, so uss ka ittabaa kero aur daro takay tum per rehmat ho
Kahen tum log yun na kaho kay kitab to sirf hum say pehlay jo do firqay thay unn per nazil hui thi, aur hum unn kay parhney parhaney say mehaz bey khabar thay

Ya yun na kaho kay agar hum per koi kitab nazil hoti to hum unn say bhi ziyadah raah raast per hotay. So abb tumharay pass tumharay rab kay pass say aik kitab wazeh aur rehnumaee ka zariye aur rehmat chuki hai. Abb uss shakhs say ziyadah zalim kaun hoga jo humari unn aayaton ko jhoota bataye aur uss say rokay. Hum jald hi unn logon ko jo kay humari aayaton say roktay hain unn kay uss rokney kay sabab sakht saza den gay

Kiya yeh log sirf uss amar kay muntazir hain kay unn kay pass farishtay aayen ya unn kay pass aap ka rab aaye ya aap kay rab ki koi (bari) nishani aaye? Jiss roz aap kay rab ki koi bari nishani phonchay gi, kissi aisay shakhs ka eman uss kay kaam na aaye ga jo pehlay say eman nahi rakhta. Ya uss ney apney eman mein koi nek amal na kiya ho. Aap farma dijiye kay tum muntazir raho, hum bhi muntazir hain
Be-shak jin logon ney apney deen ko juda juda kerdiya aur giroh giroh bann gaye, aap ka unn say koi talluq nahi bus unn ka moamla Allah Taalaa kay hawalay hai. Phir unn ko unn ka kiya hua jatla gay
Jo shakhs nek kaam keray ga uss ko uss kay das gunah milen gay aur jo shakhs bura kaam keray ga uss ko uss kay barabar hi saza milay gi aur unn logon per zulm na hoga

Aap keh dijiye kay mujh ko meray rab ney aik seedha raasta bata hai kay woh aik deen mustehkum hai jo tareeqa hai Ibrahim (alaihi as-salam) ka jo Allah ki taraf yaksoo thay. Aur woh shirk kerney walon mein say na thay
Aap farma dijiye kay bil-yaqeen meri namaz aur meri sari ibadat aur mera jeena aur mera marna yeh sab khalis Allah hi ka hai jo saray jahaan ka malik hai
Uss ka koi shareek nahi aur mujh ko ussi ka hukum hua hai aur mein sab mannay walon mein say pehla hun

Aap farma dijiye kay kiya mein Allah kay siwa kissi aur ko rab bananey kay liye talash keroon halankay woh malik hai her cheez ka aur jo shakhs bhi koi amal kerta hai woh ussi per rehta hai aur koi kissi doosray ka bojh na uthaye ga. Phir tum sab ko apney rab kay pass jana hoga. Phir woh tum ko jatlaye ga jiss jiss cheez mein tum ikhtilaf kertay thay

Aur woh aisa hai jiss ney tum ko zamin mein khalifa banaya aur aik ka doosray per rutba barhaya takay tum ko aazmaye unn cheezon mein jo tum ko di hain. Bil-yaqeen aap ka rab jald saza denay wala hai aur bil-yaqeen woh waqaee bari maghfirat kerney wala meharbani kerney wala hai
